mapper.sql: document_issue_id, account_id, calc_id, doc_type, issue_no, status, file_hash, issued_by_type, issued_by_id, issued_at, revoked_at
mapper.insert: insert into document_issue (account_id, calc_id, doc_type, issue_no, status, file_content, file_hash, issued_by_type, issued_by_id, issued_at) values (#{accountId}, #{calcId}, #{docType}, #{issueNo}, #{status}, #{fileContent}, #{fileHash}, #{issuedByType}, #{issuedById}, #{issuedAt})
mapper.select: select from document_issue where account_id = #{accountId} order by issued_at desc, document_issue_id desc
select from document_issue where account_id = #{accountId} and doc_type = #{docType} and status = 'ISSUED' order by document_issue_id desc limit 1
select exists(select 1 from document_issue where issue_no = #{issueNo})
select c.name from account a join customer c on c.customer_id = a.customer_id where a.account_id = #{accountId}
